content.title: internal post
content.body:
A clothing retailer sells a shirt for a fixed MRP. A jeweller sells a piece where the price depends on the day's gold rate, the weight in grams and milligrams, the purity such as 22K or 18K, the making charges that vary by design complexity, the wastage percentage, the stone weight and quality, and whether it is a ready piece or a custom order.

Let us look at the specific challenges that make jewellery management uniquely complex for Indian jewellers:

content.html:
Introduction

You are managing precious metals that fluctuate by the hour, intricate designs crafted by skilled karigars, custom orders with emotional significance, and a maze of GST regulations that seem to change every quarter.

Running a jewellery business in India is unlike any other retail operation

Yet, walk into most jewellery stores across Mumbai, Jaipur, or Surat, and you will still find owners tracking inventory in dusty ledgers and calculating gold rates on calculators.

This is not just inefficient. It is costing you money every single day. In this guide, we will walk through why Indian jewellery businesses face unique challenges, what a specialised jewellery ERP system actually does, and how leading jewellers are using technology to scale without losing the personal touch that makes jewellery special.

The daily challenges jewellers face

  • Gold rate changes multiple times a day
  • Making charges, wastage, and stone weight vary by design
  • GST and e-invoicing rules keep changing
  • Inventory spread across showroom, vault, and karigar workshop

Want to see how JewelBiz handles this? Explore JewelBiz ERP.
